newsitem.title: USA: Norland down after lower-than-expected Q3.
newsitem.headline: Norland down after lower-than-expected Q3.

text.p: Shares in Norland Medical Systems Inc fell on Friday after it posted lower-than-expected third-quarter earnings.
Pacific Growth Equities analyst Fred Toney said the company's third-quarter earnings per share of $0.10, before a one-time charge, fell below his forecast of $0.13.
The company markets, sells and services bone densitometers used to aid in the diagnosis and monitoring of osteoporosis and other disorders.
Toney said Norland sold more units that he had expected in the quarter but its sales mix favored lower-margin units.
